Version B names all 8 scenes/prefabs (Server Lobby, EmptyMapScene, Main Menu, LoadingScreenUI, Soul, Cigarette Vendor, Field of View Source, PauseMenu); the code, art and data files are counts only. No link from the row to the B entries; found by scanning for the quoted title.

The whole page is 'what changed in the chosen days', newest first with dates, and Week starts/Days set the window. Nothing marks what the reader has already seen (no read state or diff against an earlier page).

Writes Markdown files to a folder for sending (no account needed), but also writes fidelity checklists, research measures and a raw export with contributor e-mail addresses; no single PDF/HTML/link and no copy. Frozen-mode note for the seed week: the window rebuilds the page with current code, so Version B shows 25 scenes and prefabs (Wet Floor Sign 'moved ... and rebuilt') while the saved report-B-treatment.md says 26; from-repository mode on 2021-02-08 gives the same 25 (8 changes, 104 file changes, verified by running the shared code through the .NET harness).
